properties.description:
What sys:human-channel PRESENTS to the rest of reflow2: the one place the deterministic core hands a judgement out to an LLM and takes an answer back. Two modules stand behind it — `llm` (the backend contract) and `agent` (the ambient-agent handshake).

DISTINCT FROM ifc:ambient-agent, which is `required` and points OUTWARD at the harness reflow2 asks to think. This is the INWARD face: what coherence-loop and intake call when they need a rephrase or a judgement. One is the need, the other is the offer, and a black box has both.
properties.name: Reasoning channel
